words.ex: The virus can propagate quickly among people.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以在人群中迅速传播。
words.en: To propagate something means to spread it and encourage more people to believe in it or support it.

words.ex: The error is negligible.
words.ex_cn: 这个误差可以忽略。
words.en: If you describe something as negligible, you mean that it is so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering or worrying about.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: The vines entwine around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 藤蔓缠绕在树上。
words.en: To twist or twine together; interweave.

words.tr: v. 维持生活；生存下去
words.ex: They subsist on rice and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他们靠米饭和蔬菜维持生活。
words.en: If people subsist, they are just able to obtain the food or money that they need in order to stay alive.

words.tr:
v. 使融解；解冻；变缓和
n. 融雪
words.ex: The ice begins to thaw in spring.
words.ex_cn: 冰在春天开始融化。
words.en: If ice, snow, or something else that is frozen thaws, it melts. A thaw is a period of warmer weather when snow and ice melt, usually at the end of winter.

words.tr: v. 使迷失方向；使迷惘
words.ex: The storm disoriented the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 风暴使徒步者迷失了方向。
words.en: To cause someone to lose their sense of direction or to become confused.

words.tr: adj. 坦率的；坦诚的；偷拍的
words.ex: He gave a candid answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了坦率的回答。
words.en: If you are candid, you are honest and say what you really think.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.ex: The cactus has succulent leaves to store water.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌有多汁的叶子来储存水分。
words.en: (of food) tender, juicy, and tasty; (of a plant) having thick, fleshy tissues adapted to water storage.

words.ex: He is proactive in solving problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决问题时很积极主动。
words.en: If you are proactive, you take action to make things happen rather than waiting for them to happen to you.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: He could not conceive a world without technology.
words.ex_cn: 他无法设想一个没有科技的世界。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; to become pregnant.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: He tried to retaliate by spreading rumors.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过散布谣言来报复。
words.en: If you retaliate when someone harms or annoys you, you do something which harms or annoys them in return.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.ex: He quit smoking to avoid nicotine.
words.ex_cn: 他戒烟以避免尼古丁。
words.en: Nicotine is a toxic colorless or yellowish oily liquid that is the chief active constituent of tobacco. It acts as a stimulant in small doses, but in larger amounts blocks the action of autonomic nerve and skeletal muscle cells.

words.ex: The remnant of the old wall still stands.
words.ex_cn: 这堵旧墙的残余部分仍然矗立着。
words.en: A remnant is a small remaining quantity of something.

words.ex: A fleck of paint fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 一小片油漆掉在了地上。
words.en: A fleck is a small mark or spot, especially one that is different in color or texture from the area around it.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: Her performance was phenomenal.
words.ex_cn: 她的表现非常非凡。
words.en: If you describe something as phenomenal, you think it is extremely good or impressive.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: The car depreciates every year.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车每年都会贬值。
words.en: If something such as a currency depreciates or if something depreciates it, it loses some of its original value.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.ex: The genesis of the story is a simple dream.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的起源是一个简单的梦。
words.en: The origin or mode of formation of something.

words.ex: The car had a malfunction in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的发动机出现了故障。
words.en: If a machine or device malfunctions, it fails to work properly.

words.ex: The metal showed deformation under heavy pressure.
words.ex_cn: 金属在重压下发生了变形。
words.en: Deformation is the process of changing the shape of something, usually by applying force or pressure.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: adj.  忧郁的；阴沉的；阴暗的
words.ex: The room had a somber mood.
words.ex_cn: 房间里有一种阴郁的气氛。
words.en: If someone is somber, they are serious or sad.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.ex: He looked at the lie with contempt.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you have contempt for someone or something, you have no respect for them or think that they are unimportant.

words.tr: adj. 虔诚的；信神的；伪善的
words.ex: He is a pious man who prays every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天祈祷的虔诚的人。
words.en: Someone who is pious is very religious and moral.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: The small plant grew in a crevice of the rock.
words.ex_cn: 这棵小植物长在岩石的裂隙里。
words.en: A crevice is a narrow crack or gap, especially in a rock.

words.tr: adj. 可渗透的；可渗入的；
words.ex: The soil is permeable, so water passes through easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤是可渗透的，所以水很容易通过。
words.en: If a substance is permeable, it allows liquids or gases to pass through it.

words.tr:
n. 精巧动作；军事演习；花招
v. （熟练地）移动；操控；算计
words.ex: The dancer's maneuver was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 舞者的精巧动作令人叹为观止。
words.en: A maneuver is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The government wants to eradicate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消灭贫困。
words.en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.

words.tr: adj. 无结论的；非决定性的；不确定的
words.ex: The test results were inconclusive.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果没有定论。
words.en: If research or evidence is inconclusive, it has not proved anything.

words.tr:
n. 卷轴；
v. 卷动；
words.ex: He unrolled the ancient scroll.
words.ex_cn: 他展开了一卷古老的卷轴。
words.en: A scroll is a roll of paper or parchment with writing or pictures on it. As a verb, to scroll means to move displayed text or graphics on a screen in a particular direction in order to view different parts of them.

words.ex: The rotten food has a bad odor.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂的食物有一种难闻的气味。
words.en: An odor is a particular and distinctive smell.

words.ex: He felt hatred for the man who hurt his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨那个伤害他兄弟的人。
words.en: Hatred is an extremely strong feeling of dislike for someone or something.

words.ex: He runs a mercantile shop in the old town.
words.ex_cn: 他在老城区经营一家商业店铺。
words.en: relating to trade or commerce; commercial.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: adj. 能吃苦耐劳的；耐寒的；
words.ex: He is a hardy farmer who works in the field all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能吃苦耐劳的农民，整天在田里干活。
words.en: Someone who is hardy is strong and able to cope with difficult conditions.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr: adj. 疏忽的；粗心的；不在意的
words.ex: He was negligent in doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业时很疏忽。
words.en: If you say that someone is negligent, you mean that they do not take enough care over something that they are responsible for.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.ex: He spoke with sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地说话。
words.en: Sincerity is the quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

words.ex: The word 'cat' has one syllable.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cat' 有一个音节。
words.en: A syllable is a unit of organization for a sequence of speech sounds. It is typically made up of a syllable nucleus (most often a vowel) with optional initial and final margins (typically, consonants).

words.tr: n. 美容院；美发厅；沙龙
words.ex: She goes to the salon to get her hair cut.
words.ex_cn: 她去理发店剪头发。
words.en: A salon is a gathering of people under the roof of an inspiring host, held partly to amuse one another and partly to refine the taste and increase the knowledge of the participants through conversation.

words.ex: Poverty can engender crime.
words.ex_cn: 贫困会引起犯罪。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr:
v. 细述；叙述
n. 叙述；重新计票
words.ex: He tried to recount the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向警察重新叙述那场事故。
words.en: To recount means to tell someone about something that happened, often in detail; or to count something again to make sure the number is correct.

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的到来改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr:
n. 巡逻
v. 巡逻
words.ex: The police patrol the street at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察晚上在街上巡逻。
words.en: A patrol is a group of soldiers or vehicles that are guarding a place at a particular time. Patrol can also refer to the act of moving around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: He was wary of strangers who offered free gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他对那些提供免费礼物的陌生人保持谨慎。
words.en: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.tr: adj. 虚弱的；衰弱的；无力的；
words.ex: The old man gave a feeble smile.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人露出虚弱的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as feeble, you mean that they are weak.

words.ex: The wolf howl at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: If a dog or wolf howls, it makes a long, loud, crying sound. If a person howls, they make a long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or unhappiness.

words.ex: The wind turbine spins to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机旋转以发电。
words.en: A turbine is a machine or engine which uses a stream of air, gas, water, or steam to turn a wheel and produce power.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.tr: v. 公开承认；宣布；声称
words.ex: He professes to love music.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己热爱音乐。
words.en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it.

words.ex: The math proof requires rigor.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学证明需要严谨。
words.en: Rigor is a situation in which people are made to follow rules in a very strict way.

words.tr:
adj. 唯一的；
n. 鞋底；
words.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。
words.en: If you describe something as the sole thing of a particular kind, you mean that it is the only one of that kind.

words.tr: v. 邀请；“invite”的现在分词； adj. 诱人的；吸引人的；
words.ex: He is inviting his friends to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在邀请他的朋友来吃晚饭。
words.en: If you describe something as inviting, you mean that it has good qualities that attract you or make you want to experience it.

words.ex: His story is far-fetched and not believable.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事牵强附会，不可信。
words.en: If you describe a story or idea as far-fetched, you mean that it is very unlikely to be true or practical.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.ex: That park was in its heyday in the 1990s.
words.ex_cn: 那个公园在20世纪90年代是它的鼎盛时期。
words.en: The period of a person's or thing's greatest success, popularity, or vigor.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；外形；等高线
v. 画轮廓（画等高线）
adj. 显示轮廓的
words.ex: The map shows the contour of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山的轮廓。
words.en: The outline of a figure, body, or mass, especially the curved shape of a surface.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 详细检查；仔细察看
words.ex: The teacher scrutinizes every student's homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师仔细检查每位学生的作业。
words.en: If you scrutinize something, you examine it very carefully, often to find out some information from it or about it.

words.tr: adj. 倾向一方的；不平衡的；悬殊的
words.ex: The game was lopsided, and one team won by 10 points.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛比分悬殊，一支队伍以10分获胜。
words.en: Something that is lopsided is uneven because one side is lower or heavier than the other.

words.ex: The heroic firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这位英勇的消防员从着火的房子里救出了孩子。
words.en: If you describe a person or their actions as heroic, you admire them because they show extreme bravery.

words.ex: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一瓶酒。
words.en: Liquor is an alcoholic drink that is made by distillation rather than by fermentation.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr:
v. 吼叫；咆哮
n. 吼叫；咆哮
words.ex: The lion let out a loud roar.
words.ex_cn: 狮子发出了一声响亮的咆哮。
words.en: If something roars, it makes a very loud noise, like the sound of a lion.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.ex: The coach endorses the new player.
words.ex_cn: 教练支持这位新球员。
words.en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.ex: He has a penchant for sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 他偏爱甜食。
words.en: A penchant is a strong liking or taste for something.

words.ex: The fireworks at night were a beautiful spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的烟花是一场美丽的奇观。
words.en: A spectacle is a visually striking performance or display.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.ex: He believes in an egalitarian society where everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他相信一个人人平等的平等主义社会。
words.en: Egalitarian is used to describe something that is based on the principle that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: Can you tell me the gist of the story?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我这个故事的要点吗？
words.en: The main or essential part of a matter.

words.tr: v. 厚厚地覆盖；使…窒息；闷死
words.ex: He tried to smother the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用毯子把火闷灭。
words.en: To smother someone or something means to kill them by covering their face so that they cannot breathe, or to put out a fire by covering it.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: The climate is hospitable for growing oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这种气候适合种植橙子。
words.en: If someone is hospitable, they are friendly, welcoming, and generous to guests or strangers.

words.tr: adj. 清醒的；严肃的；素淡的；
words.ex: He stayed sober after drinking only water.
words.ex_cn: 他只喝了水，保持清醒。
words.en: If you are sober, you are not drunk. If you are sober, you are serious and thoughtful.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: The body expels waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排出废物。
words.en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly or broken the rules.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.ex: He is an industrious student who studies every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个勤勉的学生，每天都学习。
words.en: Someone who is industrious works hard and is determined.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: adj. 图上没标明的；无人涉足的；未知的
words.ex: The explorers sailed into uncharted waters.
words.ex_cn: 探险家们驶入了未被探索的水域。
words.en: If you describe a situation, experience, or activity as uncharted, you mean that it is new and unfamiliar, and therefore difficult to predict or understand.

words.ex: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有数不清的星星。
words.en: Too many to be counted; very many.

words.tr: v. 拆除窃听器；排除故障
words.ex: The technician came to debug the phone.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员来拆除电话里的窃听器。
words.en: To debug is to identify and remove errors from computer hardware or software.

words.tr: n. 前进；进展；间隔时间
words.ex: He made headway in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题上取得了进展。
words.en: If you make headway, you progress towards achieving something.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The project cost overrun the budget.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成本超过了预算。
words.en: If an army or a group of people overruns a place, they take control of it by force. If something such as a place or a piece of land is overrun by things or people, it is filled with them and they spread everywhere.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.tr: adj. 资源丰富的；机敏的；足智多谋的
words.ex: He is a resourceful man who can fix anything with little material.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个资源丰富的男人，能用很少的材料修好任何东西。
words.en: If someone is resourceful, they are good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

words.tr: v. 作为…的典型；代表；象征
words.ex: He typifies a true leader.
words.ex_cn: 他代表了一位真正的领导者。
words.en: If something or someone typifies a situation or type of behavior, they have all the usual characteristics of it and are a typical example of it.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: The motif of love appears in many poems.
words.ex_cn: 爱的主题出现在许多诗歌中。
words.en: A motif is a design or pattern that is used in a piece of art or music, or a theme that is repeated in a work of literature.

words.tr: adj. 歇斯底里的；异常激动的
words.ex: She became hysterical when she lost her wallet.
words.ex_cn: 她丢了钱包时变得歇斯底里。
words.en: If someone is hysterical, they are in a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic, often because of a shock or a very upsetting experience.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.ex: There are legion stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A legion is a large group of soldiers who form a section of an army, especially in ancient Rome. It can also refer to a large number of people or things.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.tr:
adj. 瘸的；跛的；站不住脚的；无说服力的
v. 变跛；瘸行
words.ex: The lame dog walked slowly on three legs.
words.ex_cn: 那只瘸狗用三条腿慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is lame, they are unable to walk properly because of damage to one or both of their legs. A lame excuse, explanation, etc. is one that is weak and difficult to believe.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.tr: n. 异常事物；反常现象；
words.ex: The strange weather this month is an anomaly.
words.ex_cn: 这个月奇怪的天气是一个异常现象。
words.en: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.tr: adj. 需要久坐的；惯于久坐不动的；不爱活动的；
words.ex: His sedentary job makes him sit all day.
words.ex_cn: 他的久坐工作让他整天坐着。
words.en: Someone who has a sedentary lifestyle or job sits down a lot of the time and does not take much exercise.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: The ceremony was solemn and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 仪式庄严而安静。
words.en: Solemn means very serious and not cheerful, often because something important or sad is happening or being remembered.

words.ex: He gave a stellar performance in the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在剧中表现出色。
words.en: Of or relating to stars; outstanding or excellent.

words.tr: adj. 自鸣得意的；沾沾自喜的
words.ex: He smiled in a smug way after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后得意地笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone is smug, you are criticizing the fact they seem very pleased with how good, clever, or lucky they are.

words.tr:
n. 冲天火箭
v. 剧增；猛涨；猛升
words.ex: The price of housing skyrocketed last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年房价急剧上涨。
words.en: To increase very quickly and suddenly.

words.tr:
adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的
v. （使）厌倦；厌烦
words.ex: He looked weary after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后看起来很疲惫。
words.en: If you are weary, you are very tired.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.ex: It is improbable that he will arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 他准时到达的可能性很小。
words.en: If you describe something as improbable, you mean it is unlikely to be true or to happen.

words.tr: v. 滥伐…的森林；乱砍…的树木
words.ex: They deforest the land to build houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们砍伐森林来建造房屋。
words.en: To deforest means to remove the trees from an area of land.

words.ex: Cats and dogs can coexist in the same house.
words.ex_cn: 猫和狗可以在同一个房子里共存。
words.en: To exist together at the same time or in the same place.

words.ex: The injury impaired his ability to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤损害了他走路的能力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: The company will consolidate two departments next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将合并两个部门。
words.en: To consolidate something means to make it stronger, more secure, or more solid.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.tr:
n. 不信任；名誉丧失；信誉丧失
v. 不信；败坏名声；使丢脸
words.ex: His lies brought discredit to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他的谎言使公司失去了信任。
words.en: To discredit someone or something means to cause them to lose people's respect or trust.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: He tries to synthesize ideas from different books.
words.ex_cn: 他试图综合来自不同书籍的想法。
words.en: To synthesize means to combine different ideas, influences, or objects into a new whole, or to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something shatters or is shattered, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: The village has a sparse population.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄人口稀少。
words.en: Something that is sparse is small in number or amount and spread out over an area.

words.tr: n. 不纯，不洁；杂质；不纯的东西
words.ex: The water has an impurity that makes it unsafe to drink.
words.ex_cn: 水中有一种杂质，使其不适合饮用。
words.en: An impurity is a substance of a different type that is mixed with another substance, often making it less pure.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学的
words.ex: He wears optic glasses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴光学眼镜以便看得清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: He needs to substantiate his claim with evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他需要用证据来证实他的说法。
words.en: To substantiate a statement or a story means to supply evidence which proves that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 寿衣；裹尸布；覆盖物
v. 覆盖；遮蔽
words.ex: The body was wrapped in a white shroud.
words.ex_cn: 遗体被裹在一件白色的寿衣里。
words.en: A shroud is a cloth which is used for wrapping a dead body. It can also refer to something that covers, hides, or protects.

words.ex: The roller coaster exhilarates the children.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让孩子们感到兴奋。
words.en: To make someone feel very happy and excited.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: She is the epitome of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她是善良的典型。
words.en: A person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.

words.tr: adj. 有极大诱惑力的；不可抵抗的；
words.ex: The chocolate cake looked irresistible.
words.ex_cn: 那块巧克力蛋糕看起来极具诱惑力。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

words.ex: The mistake was trivial and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误不重要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something as trivial, you mean that it is not important or significant, or is not worth serious consideration.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: He writes a verse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上写一首诗。
words.en: A verse is one of the parts into which a poem, a song, or a chapter of the Bible or the Koran is divided.

words.ex: He imparts knowledge to his students every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天向学生传授知识。
words.en: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them. To impart a particular quality to something means to give it that quality.

words.ex: The village holds a rite every spring.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一场仪式。
words.en: A rite is a traditional ceremony that is carried out by a particular group or society, especially a religious one.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.tr: n. 特技表演；噱头；发育不良的动植物；
words.ex: The actor performed a dangerous stunt in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在电影中表演了一个危险的特技。
words.en: A stunt is a dangerous feat that is done to entertain people, especially in a film.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的； v. “override”的现在分词；
words.ex: The overriding goal is to keep everyone safe.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的目标是确保每个人的安全。
words.en: An overriding issue or feeling is more important than any other.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。
words.en: A volatile situation or person is one that is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse.

words.tr: n. 神龛；神社；圣地；圣殿
words.ex: People visit the shrine to pray.
words.ex_cn: 人们去神社祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.ex: The locality has many small shops and cafes.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多小商店和咖啡馆。
words.en: A locality is a particular place or area, especially in relation to its geographical position or features.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: He is a temperate person who never shouts.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个温和的人，从不大喊大叫。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as temperate, you mean that it is calm and reasonable, not extreme or emotional.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.ex: He will delineate the plan clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他将清晰地描述这个计划。
words.en: To delineate something means to describe or portray it precisely.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.tr: adj. 无知的；缺乏知识的
words.ex: He was ignorant of the basic rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对基本规则一无所知。
words.en: If you describe someone as ignorant, you mean that they do not know things they should know. If someone is ignorant of a fact, they do not know it.

words.tr: adj. 权宜的；临时凑合的；
words.ex: He used a makeshift table made of boxes and a board.
words.ex_cn: 他用箱子和木板做了一个权宜的桌子。
words.en: A makeshift object or arrangement is one that is made or done quickly and without much skill, using whatever is available at the time.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.ex: He is invariably late for meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是开会迟到。
words.en: If something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is always true.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.tr: adj. 狭窄的； v. “cramp”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The tiny room was cramped and hard to move in.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间很狭窄，很难活动。
words.en: If a place is cramped, it is not big enough for the people or things in it, so that it is difficult to move around or to use things properly.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；安详的
words.ex: The lake is serene in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: Calm, peaceful, and untroubled; tranquil.

words.ex: This decision is pivotal for the company's future.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对公司未来至关重要。
words.en: Of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something else.

words.ex: The fallen tree impeded the car's path.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树阻碍了汽车的前进。
words.en: To impede something means to make its movement, development, or progress difficult.

words.tr:
v. 稀释
adj. 经稀释的
words.ex: He dilutes the juice with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水稀释果汁。
words.en: To dilute a liquid means to make it thinner or weaker by adding water or another liquid to it.

words.ex: The punishment was disproportionate to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚与罪行不成比例。
words.en: Something that is disproportionate is surprisingly large or small in comparison to something else.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.tr: n. 前景；最显著的位置；
words.ex: The trees in the foreground are very tall.
words.ex_cn: 前景中的树很高。
words.en: The part of a view that is nearest to the observer, especially in a picture or photograph; the most important or prominent position.

words.tr: adj. 异种的；异质的；由不同成份形成的
words.ex: The class is heterogeneous, with students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级是多元的，有来自许多国家的学生。
words.en: A heterogeneous group consists of many different types of things or people.

words.tr: n. 死记硬背；机械的做法；生搬硬套
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote is the process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；不关心的；
words.ex: He was indifferent to the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

words.ex: The forest remained pristine and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林保持原始且未被破坏。
words.en: Something that is pristine is in its original condition and has not been spoiled or damaged.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: He tried to decipher the secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他试图破译那个秘密代码。
words.en: To decipher something means to convert it from a code into normal language or to understand something that is difficult to understand or that is not obvious.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.tr: adj. 炎热的；炽热的；情欲强烈的
words.ex: The torrid sun burned the dry land.
words.ex_cn: 炎热的太阳炙烤着干涸的土地。
words.en: If you describe something as torrid, you mean that it is very hot and dry.

words.tr:
n. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
v. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
words.ex: The flowers showed signs of wilt after the long heat.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在长时间高温后出现了枯萎的迹象。
words.en: If a plant wilts, it bends over because it is too dry, too hot, or too weak to stay upright.

words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.ex: The children are vibrant and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们充满活力。
words.en: If you describe something as vibrant, you mean that it is bright, lively, and full of energy.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.tr: adj. 典范的；可做模范的；惩戒性的
words.ex: He is an exemplary student who always finishes his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名模范学生，总是完成作业。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as exemplary, you think they are extremely good and suitable to be copied by other people.

words.ex: He inhale the fresh air in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他早上吸入新鲜空气。
words.en: To inhale means to breathe in air, smoke, or gas.

words.ex: The kitchen is hygienic and clean.
words.ex_cn: 厨房卫生且干净。
words.en: Something that is hygienic is clean and unlikely to cause illness.

words.ex: The sun can dehydrate your skin quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会很快使你的皮肤脱水。
words.en: To dehydrate something means to remove all the water from it, often in order to preserve it. If you dehydrate, you lose too much water from your body, usually because of illness or extreme heat.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.ex: She mourns her dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都在哀悼她的狗。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or regret for someone or something.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.ex: The handwriting is legible and easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 字迹清晰，容易辨认。
words.en: If writing or print is legible, it is clear enough to read.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的；
words.ex: A passport is a requisite for international travel.
words.ex_cn: 护照是国际旅行所必需的。
words.en: Something that is necessary for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.ex: His creed is to always tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的信条是永远说真话。
words.en: A creed is a set of beliefs, principles, or opinions that strongly influence the way people live or work.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.ex: The child showed obedience to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母表现出顺从。
words.en: Obedience is the act of following orders or instructions from someone in authority.

words.ex: The outcome is foreseeable.
words.ex_cn: 结果是可以预见的。
words.en: If a future event is foreseeable, you know that it will happen or that it can happen, because it is a natural or obvious result of something else that you know.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的； v. “impend”的现在分词；
words.ex: An impending storm made people stay indoors.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴让人们待在室内。
words.en: If an event or situation is impending, it is about to happen or is likely to happen very soon.

words.ex: He had a loud hiccup during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间打了个响亮的嗝。
words.en: A hiccup is an involuntary spasm of the diaphragm and respiratory organs, with a sudden closure of the glottis and a characteristic sound.

words.ex: The shop tries to entice customers with cheap prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店试图以低价吸引顾客。
words.en: If you entice someone, you attract them to a particular place or activity by making it seem attractive or interesting.

words.ex: He shirks his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天逃避作业。
words.en: If someone shirks their duties or responsibilities, they deliberately avoid doing them.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.ex: The argument started small but soon escalate.
words.ex_cn: 争论起初很小，但很快逐步升高。
words.en: If a bad situation escalates or if someone or something escalates it, it becomes greater in size, seriousness, or intensity.

words.ex: Cleaning the whole house is a laborious task.
words.ex_cn: 打扫整个房子是一项耗时费力的任务。
words.en: If you describe a task or job as laborious, you mean that it takes a lot of time and effort.

words.ex: She confides in her best friend.
words.ex_cn: 她向最好的朋友倾诉。
words.en: If you confide in someone, you tell them a secret.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: n. 弹回；反响；后果；反射
words.ex: The ball showed a clear repercussion off the wall.
words.ex_cn: 球从墙上明显地弹回。
words.en: The effect that an action, event, or decision has on something, especially a bad effect.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: He outdid his brother in the math competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中胜过了他的哥哥。
words.en: To outdo someone means to be more successful than them in a particular activity.

words.ex: The movie was mediocre and not worth watching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很平庸，不值得看。
words.en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

words.tr:
v. 阻碍；妨碍
n. （带盖）篮子
words.ex: Rain hampered our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨妨碍了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If something hampers you, it makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.tr: v. 确定；定案；最终确定
words.ex: He will finalize the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会最终确定这个计划。
words.en: To finalize something means to complete all the arrangements for it, especially by discussing it with other people involved.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.ex: He fabricates excuses to avoid work.
words.ex_cn: 他编造借口来逃避工作。
words.en: To fabricate means to invent or produce something false in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: adj. 世俗的；非宗教的；长期的
words.ex: He lives a secular life without religion.
words.ex_cn: 他过着没有宗教的世俗生活。
words.en: Secular activities, attitudes, or things have no connection with religion.

words.ex: The team showed cohesive behavior during the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队在项目期间表现出有凝聚力的行为。
words.en: If something is cohesive, it consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

words.ex: The tree's silhouette stood against the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 树的剪影映在落日背景下。
words.en: A silhouette is the dark shape and outline of someone or something visible against a lighter background, especially in dim light.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: The storm was formidable and destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴很可怕，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 卓越的；著名的；
words.ex: He distinguished the fake coin from the real one.
words.ex_cn: 他把假硬币和真硬币区分开来。
words.en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.tr: adj. 不注意的；疏忽的；非故意的
words.ex: He made an inadvertent mistake while typing.
words.ex_cn: 他在打字时不小心犯了个错误。
words.en: If something bad is inadvertent, it is done without realizing that it is wrong or that it could have bad consequences.

words.tr:
n. 大洪水；暴雨；泛滥
v. 泛滥；大量涌入
words.ex: The rain caused a deluge in the town.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨在镇上引发了洪水。
words.en: A deluge is a severe flood or a very heavy fall of rain that causes a lot of damage.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.ex: There is a paucity of water in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很少。
words.en: If you say that there is a paucity of something, you mean that there is not enough of it.

words.ex: He hastened to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他赶紧在晚饭前写完作业。
words.en: If you hasten to do something, you quickly do it or quickly go somewhere.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.tr: v. 消灭；毁掉；清除；抹除
words.ex: The bomb will obliterate the building.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹会摧毁那栋大楼。
words.en: To obliterate something means to remove all signs of it or to destroy it completely.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: He wore a ragged coat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿着一件破旧的外套。
words.en: Clothes that are ragged are old and torn.

words.tr:
v. 害怕；畏惧
n. 恐惧；畏惧
words.ex: He dreads going to the dentist.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕去看牙医。
words.en: If you dread something, you fear it intensely.

words.tr:
v. 洒；撒；下小雨
n. 洒；撒；小雨；少量
words.ex: She sprinkles sugar on her cereal.
words.ex_cn: 她在麦片上撒糖。
words.en: To scatter or pour small drops or particles of a substance over an object or surface.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.ex: The desert looks desolate and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来荒凉而空旷。
words.en: If you describe a place as desolate, you mean that it is empty and looks sad because there are no people there or because it has been damaged.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: Wear a helmet as a precaution when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔作为一种预防措施。
words.en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

words.ex: The nail protrudes from the wood.
words.ex_cn: 钉子从木头里凸出来。
words.en: If something protrudes from somewhere, it sticks out.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr:
v. 旋动；（使）成漩涡；盘旋
n. 漩涡；涡状形
words.ex: The milk swirls in the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶在咖啡里旋转。
words.en: If something swirls or if you swirl it, it moves around and around quickly.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.tr: adj. 优先的；优待的；特惠的；
words.ex: Children get preferential treatment at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里享有优先待遇。
words.en: If something is preferential, it involves giving an advantage to a particular person or group.

words.tr: n. 天花乱坠的广告宣传；炒作；
words.ex: The new phone got a lot of hype before its release.
words.ex_cn: 这款新手机在发布前受到了大量天花乱坠的广告宣传。
words.en: If someone or something is hyped, they are praised or advertised a lot in newspapers, on television, etc., especially in a way that is intended to make them seem very exciting or important.

words.ex: The riddle perplexed the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜语让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.ex: He overheard them talking about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中听到他们在谈论派对。
words.en: To overhear is to hear what someone is saying without them knowing that you are listening.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: He made an abrupt stop at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前突然停了下来。
words.en: If something happens abruptly, it happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The damage to the environment is irreversible.
words.ex_cn: 对环境的破坏是不可逆转的。
words.en: If a change is irreversible, it cannot be changed back to how it was before.

words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.ex: He squandered all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都浪费在游戏上了。
words.en: If you squander money, resources, or opportunities, you waste them in a foolish or careless way.

words.ex: His devotion to his family is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 他对家庭的献身显而易见。
words.en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone or something.

words.ex: The joy was transient, like a brief smile.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是短暂的，像一个短暂的微笑。
words.en: If you describe something as transient, you mean that it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；发微光
n. 微光；闪光
words.ex: The lake shimmers under the moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 湖面在月光下闪烁。
words.en: To shine with a soft, slightly wavering light.

words.ex: He persevered despite many failures.
words.ex_cn: 尽管多次失败，他仍然坚持不懈。
words.en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.ex: The climber fell into a deep crevasse.
words.ex_cn: 登山者掉进了一个深裂缝中。
words.en: A crevasse is a deep crack or fissure in ice or a glacier.

words.ex: I concur with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的观点。
words.en: If one person concurs with another person, the first person agrees with the second person.

words.ex: The resilient child bounced back quickly after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这个适应力强的孩子在事故后很快恢复了。
words.en: Something that is resilient is strong and not easily damaged by being hit, stretched, or squeezed.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.ex: He finally conceded defeat after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他终于承认失败了。
words.en: If you concede something, you admit, often unwillingly, that it is true or correct.

words.ex: They believed there was a conspiracy to hide the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他们相信有人密谋隐瞒真相。
words.en: A conspiracy is a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；功利主义的；
words.ex: The chair is utilitarian and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子实用又舒适。
words.en: Utilitarian means relating to or adhering to the belief that the value of a thing or an action is determined by its utility.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.tr: v. 滥伐…的森林；乱砍…的树木
words.ex: They deforest the land to build houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们砍伐森林来建造房屋。
words.en: To deforest means to remove the trees from an area of land.

words.ex: Overgrazing causes desertification in dry areas.
words.ex_cn: 过度放牧会导致干旱地区的沙漠化。
words.en: Desertification is the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.tr: phrase. 绝缘效应；隔热效果；隔离作用
words.ex: The snow has an insulating effect on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪对地面有保温作用。
words.en: The property of a material to resist the flow of heat or electricity.

words.ex: The land is semiarid and has little rain.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地是半干旱的，降雨很少。
words.en: Describing a climate or region that is partially dry, receiving moderate but insufficient rainfall for lush vegetation.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The monsoon brings heavy rain to India each summer.
words.ex_cn: 季风每年夏天给印度带来大雨。
words.en: A monsoon is a seasonal wind in South and Southeast Asia, blowing from the southwest between May and September and bringing rain (the wet monsoon), or from the northeast between October and April (the dry monsoon).

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: The radioactivity of the material is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料的放射性很危险。
words.en: The emission of ionizing radiation or particles caused by the spontaneous disintegration of atomic nuclei.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr: phrase. 地热能；地球内部产生的热能，用于发电或供暖
words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal energy is heat derived within the sub-surface of the earth. Water and/or steam carry the geothermal energy to the Earth's surface. Depending on its characteristics, geothermal energy can be used for heating and cooling purposes or be harnessed to generate clean electricity.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.ex: The apple will decompose in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 苹果会在土壤中分解。
words.en: If something decomposes, or if it is decomposed, it decays or breaks down into smaller parts or substances.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.ex: The smoke from the factory is noxious.
words.ex_cn: 工厂的烟雾是有害的。
words.en: Something that is noxious is harmful or poisonous.

words.ex: The earthquake caused total devastation in the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: The state of being devastated; severe and widespread destruction or damage.

words.ex: The factory was fined for dumping industrial sewage into the river.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂因向河里排放工业污水而被罚款。
words.en: Industrial sewage refers to the waste water produced by industrial activities, which often contains harmful chemicals and pollutants.

words.ex: The town uses tidal energy to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用潮汐能发电。
words.en: Tidal energy is the energy obtained from the movement of water due to the gravitational forces between the Earth, the Moon, and the Sun, which causes the tides. It is a form of renewable energy that can be harnessed to generate electricity.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.tr: phrase. 水晶棱镜；一种由水晶制成的光学器件，能将光线分解成不同颜色的光谱
words.ex: The crystal prism splits sunlight into rainbow colors.
words.ex_cn: 水晶棱镜将阳光分解成彩虹色。
words.en: A transparent solid object with flat, polished surfaces that refract light.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: The camera provides high-resolution images.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机提供了高分辨率的图像。
words.en: High-resolution refers to the level of detail an image holds. The higher the resolution, the more detail the image has.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The bridge collapsed due to resonance from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 桥梁因风引起的共振而坍塌。
words.en: Resonance is the quality in a sound of being deep, full, and reverberating.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: The boy fixed the electric circuit with a wire.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用一根电线修好了电路。
words.en: An electric circuit is a path in which electrons from a voltage or current source flow.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
